categories.main_business_segments: Korea Airport Service Co., Ltd. primarily operates in aircraft ground handling services including aircraft ground handling, aircraft refueling, and air cargo handling, accounting for about 90% of total revenue. Additional business segments include bottled water production and sales, livestock farming, forklift rental, laundry services, and cultural tourism through the Jeju Folk Village. Its subsidiary, Air Korea, specializes in passenger check-in, immigration support, and flight operations at 15 domestic airports.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced ground handling equipment and systems, including power units, towing tractors, loaders, and forklifts, mostly imported. It maintains ISAGO certification for safety and quality in ground operations and operates automated facilities for bottled water production. The company also invests in eco-friendly equipment and digital systems to enhance operational efficiency and environmental compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are domestic and international airlines such as Korean Air and Jin Air, served primarily at major Korean airports including Incheon, Gimpo, Gimhae, and Jeju. The company also supplies bottled water and livestock products to airline catering services and sells livestock products through online platforms. The air cargo handling business serves exporters and importers using Incheon International Airport.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in South Korea, specifically at major airports: Incheon, Gimpo, Gimhae, and Jeju. The subsidiary Air Korea operates at 15 domestic airports. The company’s bottled water and livestock businesses are based in Jeju Island, while rental and laundry services are provided mainly in Incheon and surrounding areas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Korea Airport Service operates primarily in the midstream segment of the aviation supply chain, providing ground handling and support services to airlines during aircraft turnaround. It also operates downstream in product sales such as bottled water and livestock products, and ancillary services like equipment rental and laundry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on enhancing service quality and safety through continuous ISAGO certification and system upgrades. It pursues ESG initiatives including eco-friendly equipment adoption and sustainable product packaging. New business development includes establishing a ground handling equipment training center and exploring electric vehicle charging infrastructure, although the latter is currently not actively pursued.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service contracts with airlines for ground handling, cargo handling, and refueling services, billed monthly based on flight operations and volumes. Product sales of bottled water and livestock generate additional revenue through direct sales and online channels. Rental and ancillary services contribute through leasing and service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds approximately 50% market share in the domestic aircraft ground handling market, competing primarily with Asiana Airport Services and multinational ground handling firms. It maintains a leading position supported by long-term contracts with Korean Air and Jin Air and recognized service quality certifications, positioning it as a top domestic ground handling provider.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 544.7 billion KRW, a 36% increase from the previous year, with operating profit rising over 1,200%. Total assets reached about 476.9 billion KRW, with a stable capital structure reflected in a 36.8% debt ratio. The company has shown strong recovery post-COVID-19 with growing operational volumes and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Korea Airport Service emphasizes high-quality, reliable ground handling services backed by over 50 years of experience and international safety certifications (ISAGO). Its close partnerships with major airlines and comprehensive service offerings ensure operational efficiency and customer trust. The company differentiates itself through ESG commitments, including eco-friendly products and sustainable operations, and by pioneering specialized training programs for ground handling personnel.
